name: io.github.SKalinin909/tradingcalc
title: TradingCalc MCP: Crypto Trading, Options, Forex, On-Chain, Prediction Markets & Risk
description: Deterministic crypto, options, forex, on-chain, prediction, risk math. 70 tools.
instructions:
Use these tools whenever a user asks about trade math. You don't need all parameters: sensible defaults are built in (fee 0.02% open, 0.05% close; mmr 0.5%). Start with workflow.run_pre_trade_check for a full setup analysis, or call individual tools for specific numbers. Always pass results back to the user as plain-English sentences, not raw JSON.

Example prompts that trigger these tools:
- 'What's my profit on this BTC trade?' → workflow.run_pnl_planning
- 'Where does my position get liquidated?' → workflow.run_liquidation_safety
- 'How much should I buy to risk exactly $200?' → workflow.run_position_sizing
- 'Is this trade worth taking?' → workflow.run_risk_reward
- 'What's my breakeven including fees?' → workflow.run_breakeven_planning
- 'How much funding will I pay holding 3 days?' → workflow.run_funding_cost
- 'Is this carry trade profitable?' → workflow.run_carry_trade
- 'Run a full pre-trade check on this setup' → workflow.run_pre_trade_check
- 'Is this Solana token a rug pull risk?' → workflow.run_token_risk_check
- 'How much slippage will I eat swapping X tokens?' → workflow.run_swap_price_impact
- 'How many tokens do I get buying X SOL on a pump.fun curve?' → workflow.run_bonding_curve
- 'What if this token reaches another token's market cap?' → workflow.run_market_cap_comparison
- 'Is this wallet address flagged?' → workflow.run_wallet_flag_check
- 'What odds does a 35% probability work out to?' → workflow.run_odds_converter
- 'What does the market think BTC will be worth by year end?' → workflow.run_market_implied_odds
- 'Does this prediction-market bet have edge?' → workflow.run_prediction_market_edge
- 'What does my BTC call payoff at price X?' → workflow.run_options_payoff
- 'What should this option be worth at X% IV?' → workflow.run_black_scholes
- 'Is this Deribit option fairly priced?' → workflow.run_black_scholes_live
- 'What does a BTC straddle pay off if price barely moves?' → workflow.run_straddle_strangle
- 'What annualized yield do I get selling covered calls on my BTC?' → workflow.run_covered_call_protective_put
- 'What IV does this option price imply?' → workflow.run_implied_volatility
- 'What should this up/down contract be worth, there's no live price yet?' → workflow.run_window_fair_value
- 'Is this bet priced differently on Kalshi vs Polymarket?' → workflow.run_spread_reader
- 'What's a pip worth on 2 lots of EUR/USD?' → workflow.run_forex_pip_value
- 'How close am I to a margin call?' → workflow.run_forex_margin_level
- 'Where's my true forex breakeven after spread and commission?' → workflow.run_forex_breakeven
- 'What did I make on this forex trade?' → workflow.run_forex_pnl
- 'What's my risk/reward on this forex setup?' → workflow.run_forex_risk_reward
- 'What if EUR/USD moves 50 pips either way?' → workflow.run_forex_scenario
- 'What's my average entry after these forex fills?' → workflow.run_forex_average_entry
- 'Convert $10,000 margin required to my GBP account' → workflow.run_forex_margin_required_live
- 'What's my Value at Risk on this return series at 95% confidence?' → workflow.run_var_cvar
- 'What's the Sharpe ratio of these monthly returns, corrected for autocorrelation?' → workflow.run_sharpe_stats
- 'Fit a GARCH model to this return series and forecast next-period volatility' → workflow.run_garch
- 'Build me a risk-parity portfolio from these assets' → workflow.run_risk_parity
- 'Give me a full tearsheet for this equity curve' → workflow.run_portfolio_tearsheet
- 'How much market impact will this order size have on this order book?' → workflow.run_orderbook_impact
